name: Arisa Greuze
source:
The protagonist of this story. She was taught by her mother to never speak about their magic, as they are not some cheap illusionists but real mages from a distinguished family. However, one day she heard from somewhere that the government is searching for people with magical powers, and so she decided to use her hidden powers to save others by fighting with possessioners.

[Translated from the [url=https://archive.org/details/Possessioner_Manual/page/n1/mode/2up]manual[/url]]
